### 1. How Matrix Multiplication Uses a GPU (Plain English)

To understand why GPUs are used for matrix multiplication, you have to look at the difference between a **CPU** (Central Processing Unit) and a **GPU** (Graphics Processing Unit).

*   **The CPU (The Specialist):** A CPU has a few very powerful cores. It is great at complex, sequential tasks (like running an operating system or a single complex calculation). It has large, fast memory (cache) right next to the processor.
*   **The GPU (The Crowd):** A GPU has thousands of tiny, simpler cores. It was originally designed to process millions of pixels on a screen simultaneously. It has much slower access to its main memory but can perform thousands of simple math operations at the same time.
